intent: Retire the ruled destructive Hindsight rederive command and make Story Weaver read-status saves truthful on failed HTTP and network responses.

reasons.evidence: Story Weaver save feedback changes a user-visible response
The operator specifically ruled hindsight-rederive.sh for retirement before v1.0.0

invariants: A count-only or omitted target cannot delete a live Hindsight bank; Q-013's ruled rederive command is no longer callable.
A failed read-status POST leaves Story Weaver's local read status unsaved and gives visible feedback for HTTP and network failures.
A successful read-status save still marks the selected chapter read and preserves navigation.
rollback: Restore only a harmless count-only Hindsight command if still needed; never restore a live-destructive default. Revert Story Weaver feedback only with an equivalent failure-safe save implementation that passes the same browser oracle.
verify_line: The specifically ruled Hindsight rederive entrypoint is absent and cannot delete a live bank by default; unsuccessful HTTP and network chapter saves leave read status unsaved with visible error at 1440 and 390 widths, while successful saves mark read and navigation remains usable.
approval: The operator approved prerelease T-0180–T-0187 on 2026-09-28 and specifically ruled hindsight-rederive.sh for deletion in Q-013. H1 and A1 were independently rechecked in org/reviews/2026-09-t0164-defects.md.
oracle_provenance: The coordinator authored the R2 oracle before any source change: tests/unit/hindsight-rederive-safety.test.ts SHA-256 F676B063232BEE1FB09E24F2ACC51DA42B798000DFA16595039737504556265F and tests/e2e/story-weaver-save-failure.spec.ts SHA-256 A5BBA95DC99077457D56D637BF02C3881AEBD2C637D182660517D4ED02D31053. The unit removal assertion failed as intended, with the dangerous script still present. The owned isolated Playwright listener on port 3998 ran six cases at 1440x900 and 390x844: four failed at the intended missing save-error alert, while both successful-save controls passed. TypeScript passed. This oracle was frozen before source repair. After independent sceptic review exposed two further save gaps, distinct ORACLE 01a0ee69-17d0-74d1-b624-de37ec9e1477 authored only tests/e2e/story-weaver-save-boundaries.spec.ts SHA-256 AF247F24C263422DF273462605667755C2443AEF050172EE2B636E4D5EB17660. Its fixture models the actual server merge by chapter number. Against the still-unfixed save implementation, the ORACLE and coordinator each observed ten intended failures and two passing confirmed-save/reload controls across 1440x900 and 390x844. The supplemental oracle is frozen before the corresponding source repair.
claim_expansion: An independent read-only sceptic found two defects in the initial implementation: overlapping selections can send stale full chapter arrays and erase a read mark on the server, and a 200 response without confirmed saved chapter data is treated as success. The existing basic oracle does not cover either. A separate ORACLE owns a new suite with red-first proof; the existing frozen suite remains unchanged.
